SELECT ps.fundflux, ps.source_sum, ps.source_sum / totals.grand_sum AS sum_share
FROM (
  SELECT p.fundflux, SUM(grouped.record_count) AS source_sum
  FROM (
    SELECT q.arcref AS project_id, p.fundflux, COUNT(*) AS record_count
    FROM scanqc AS q
    JOIN projects AS p ON q.arcref = p.arcregistry COLLATE BINARY
    GROUP BY q.arcref, p.fundflux
  ) AS grouped
  JOIN projects AS p ON grouped.project_id = p.arcregistry COLLATE BINARY
    AND grouped.fundflux IS p.fundflux
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
) AS ps
JOIN (
  SELECT SUM(source_sum) AS grand_sum
  FROM (
    SELECT p.fundflux, SUM(grouped.record_count) AS source_sum
    FROM (
      SELECT q.arcref AS project_id, p.fundflux, COUNT(*) AS record_count
      FROM scanqc AS q
      JOIN projects AS p ON q.arcref = p.arcregistry COLLATE BINARY
      GROUP BY q.arcref, p.fundflux
    ) AS grouped
    JOIN projects AS p ON grouped.project_id = p.arcregistry COLLATE BINARY
      AND grouped.fundflux IS p.fundflux
    GROUP BY p.fundflux
  )
) AS totals
WHERE totals.grand_sum IS NOT NULL
